name: AllForOne Transition
description: Many transitions in one effect: repeated shape grids (diamond, hexagon, circle, square, triangle, star, heart, plus, octagon, rhombus), hex tiles, pixel ring, linear, radial, iris, barn doors, blinds, mosaic, spiral and wave wipes, page roll, box flip, zoom, spin, swirl, pixelate, slide, card flip and ripple. Ported from Shadertoy.
